title: Residency exceptions, audit-ready evidence export, and retention enforcement for hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Customers need precise, auditable controls for Hosted API data residency and retention: pinning requests to regions, expressing short-lived exceptions (e.g., cross-region failover, migration windows), and generating evidence bundles for compliance reviews. Current routing and retention controls lack exception semantics, signed evidence exports, and a clear admin UX for time-bound pins. This ticket scopes a product-first implementation that ties configuration (UI/API), enforcement at the routing layer, retention lifecycle automation, and auditable reporting together.
acceptance_criteria: Admin UX: tenant admins can create region-pin rules and time-bound exceptions with explanation and TTL; changes are recorded in audit log with actor, timestamp, and justification
API: new hosted API parameter and account-level config for preferred_region(s) and exception windows documented in REST/SDK docs
Enforcement: routing honors pins and exceptions with deterministic fallback policy; requests violating pinned residency return explicit 403-level telemetry event and a routed-fallback when allowed
Retention: per-tenant retention windows enforce automated deletion for transitory data and produce retention state changes in audit logs

Evidence export: compliance bundle generator produces signed, time-stamped ZIP manifest containing routing logs, retention-actions, and compact hashes of object inventories; bundle verifiable by customer KMS public keys
Telemetry & Dashboard: Console shows per-tenant residency compliance rate, exception usage, and outstanding retention items; alerts fire when policy drift > 0.5% over 24h
Security review: design passes security_review and external legal sign-off for exported evidence format
proposed_solution: Product: Add 'Residency rules' modal in Console (tenant-admin only) to create rules: scope (api key vs tenant), allowed_regions, primary_region, allow_cross_region_failover boolean, exception windows (start/end), justification field
API: new account endpoints /v1/residency_rules and request-level param 'region_hint' (opt-in for customer) with server-side validation

Routing: enforce rules in Smart Router: match rule -> route to same-region capacity; if unavailable and allow_cross_region_failover=false, return 421 (ResidencyConflict) with diagnostics; if true, route and tag request as 'exception'
Retention: retention-controller runs daily sweep per-tenant; deletes ephemeral payloads, snapshots deletion actions to immutable audit stream and stores deletion attestations (signed by server key)

Evidence: evidence-export job composes a minimal bundle (manifest.json, routing-log.csv.gz, retention-actions.csv.gz, signed_manifest.sig). Support for both server-signed bundles and customer KMS-signed attestations for higher assurance
Audit & Storage: store export bundles in a tenant-specific, access-controlled S3 bucket for 90 days by default; provide download link with one-time-use tokens; include checksum and sign-off metadata
Migration & Backfill: one-off backfill job to compute residency compliance for prior 90 days for customers requesting historical evidence
roll_out_plan: Phase 0 (design sign-off): finalize API shape and evidence spec; security & legal review - complete by 2026-03-12
Phase 1 (backend): implement residency rules API, router enforcement hooks, and retention-controller core - feature-flagged - targeting 2026-03-28
Phase 2 (console + docs): admin UX, evidence export UI, and SDK updates + docs - targeting 2026-04-04
Phase 3 (compliance beta): onboard 3 pilot tenants with a dedicated SRE runbook, generate sample evidence bundles, collect feedback - 2026-04-11 to 2026-04-25
Phase 4 (general availability): enable for all hosted tenants with rollout knob and release notes - targeted 2026-05-01
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Eng, Security, Legal. Agreed evidence bundle must include signed manifest and CSVs limited to hashed identifiers rather than full payloads.

2026-03-04: Engineering proposed router change: add pre-routing checkpoint that returns ResidencyConflict for strict pins. PM requested error code 421 and machine-readable 'allowed_fallbacks' field for SDK handling.
2026-03-06: Security requested HSM-backed signing for production evidence bundles. Added dependency on ENG-9051 (KMS/HSM integration).
2026-03-08: Design review: admin UX mockups v2 uploaded to Drive; design feedback to reduce steps for temporary exceptions. UX will include a 2-step justification + TTL flow.
2026-03-09: Blocker identified: existing access logs do not include explicit region tag in 20% of edge cases. ENG tracking ticket ENG-8722 created to backfill region tags in logging path.

2026-03-10: PM decision: initial rollout will be opt-in per-tenant with pilot customers; plan for automated opt-in based on contract for Dedicated later. Next: finalize API contract and evidence manifest schema.
